feasibility.explanation: No ForgeX solution is recommended because Boise Remodeling Co. is a residential design-build general contractor outside ForgeX's target segment of HVAC, plumbing, and electrical service contractors, and already operates sophisticated custom web intake and estimating automation.

aiDelivery.explanation: No ForgeX solution is recommended. Notably, the company already uses an automated drawing reader with human-in-the-loop estimator verification on its own website.

humanReview: No ForgeX automation is recommended; in the company's existing operations, human estimators review automated floor-plan reads and project managers issue written scopes and change orders.

risks.description: Selling standardized home-service trade automations (built for high-volume HVAC, plumbing, and electrical dispatch) to a long-cycle design-build remodeling contractor risks poor workflow fit.

assumptions: Although the website publishes starting planning ranges on https://boiseremodeling.co/services (such as Bathroom Remodel 'Planning from $10k' and Kitchen Remodel 'Planning from $15k'), no ForgeX solution is recommended because the company is outside ForgeX's segment and has no evidenced automation gap.
Therefore, no commercial value or implementation cost projection is claimed.

limitations: The website does not disclose total employee headcount (whether the company has 10 to 75 staff) and notes that it runs lean and subcontracts services as needed.

The website footer lists an individual under the title 'Public representative' rather than explicitly presenting them as an owner, executive, or manager; per ForgeX evidence rules, they are omitted from the named people list.
Internal back-office software (such as accounting or construction project management software behind the custom web app) cannot be verified from public pages.
State contractor registration status on dopl.idaho.gov / edopl.idaho.gov cannot be independently queried by ForgeX's site-restricted fetcher.

qualification.rationale: Boise Remodeling Co. (a DBA of P5 Home Co LLC) is a residential design-build general remodeling contractor specializing in kitchens, bathrooms, additions, whole-home renovations, and ADUs, which puts it outside ForgeX's target segment of HVAC, plumbing, and electrical service contractors with 10 to 75 staff. Furthermore, the company already operates a modern custom web stack featuring an interactive cost estimator, an automated floor-plan measurement reader with human review, a subcontractor portal, fast text response during business hours, and server-side ad conversion tracking (Meta Conversions API and Google Ads).
